judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference worker records and coordination dispositions for every conclusion about aggregation.

dimensions.description: The coordinator rejects unsupported consolidation, missing routed lenses, malformed findings, mismatched inputs, and incomplete artifacts.
Compatible finding duplicates, exact guidance duplicates, sorting, worker-declared supersession, and coverage union retain worker conclusions and every disagreement.
The coordinator performs no second review, new finding, mutation, or remediation planning.

evals.name: structural aggregation of independent findings
evals.prompt: Coordinate complete Domain and Engineering/Design worker records for the same Ticket outcome. Validate structure, group compatible duplicates, sort, union coverage, and return the Review brief.
evals.expected_output: Every source finding receives a recorded disposition, compatible duplicates remain traceable, disagreements remain separate, and incomplete input cannot become a complete brief.
expectations: The coordinator validates the planned consolidated or separate base lenses, any routed specialist lenses, matching whole-ticket inputs, complete concern coverage, ordered regions, finding fields, and artifact references.
Compatible duplicate grouping keeps every source identity and conclusion; exact guidance duplicates group separately.
Sorting follows Review level, severity, and stable identity; coverage union loses no worker, lens, region, level, or concern.
Only worker-declared, region-bounded supersession is applied and conclusion, authority, severity, confidence, and fix-direction disagreements remain visible.
The coordinator does not inspect for new issues, change conclusions, plan fixes, or mutate reviewed state.
Blind model judgment and sampled human review assess semantic grouping and preservation.
